This is a common AI artifact (fusion) rather than a valid functional component. However, given the stylized nature of the armor, I will accept it as 'present' but note the lack of mechanical detail. artifact_review: The Router identified a texture anomaly on the helmet faceplate (severity 2.0) and perspective distortion on the shoulder (severity 1.5). The Perceptual Quality Auditor added a 'compression/noise' finding (severity 0.4). The severity should arguably be higher (2.5-3.0) as it represents a failure of structural logic, not just texture. The shoulder edge bleeding is subtle but confirmed by the Topology Auditor's high confidence mask potentially hiding soft boundaries. The global purple lighting does obscure some details, but the underlying geometry holds up well.
